text.tspan: Scores after the final task. A value marked ‡ is NOT MEASURED: that run has not reached the end of the sequence,
so the bar stands in at ours' value. Tasks completed: Min-Max (ours) 3/5, CLEAR 5/5, CKA-RL 3/5, CompoNet 2/5.
Only CLEAR has finished, and it predates the threshold fix. Ours has not finished either, so ours, CKA-RL and CompoNet
stand in at the same values and are not distinguishable here.
